common_name: Oso Easy Peachy Cream Rose (Soft Peach-Cream Landscape Rose)

planting.note: Plant container-grown shrubs in spring in well-drained soil in full sun; Oso Easy Peachy Cream is part of a landscape rose series bred for disease resistance and low-maintenance repeat bloom.

directions: Plant in well-drained soil in full sun. Oso Easy Peachy Cream bears single flowers in a soft blend of peach and cream, opening in flushes from late spring through frost on a compact, low-maintenance shrub bred for strong disease resistance and continuous bloom without deadheading. Its gentle color works easily into a wide range of border and foundation plantings where spraying and fussing over roses isn't practical. Established plants tolerate heat and drought well and need only an annual light pruning in late winter to stay compact and floriferous.

common_name: Oso Easy Fragrant Spreader Rose (Fragrant Pink Spreading Landscape Rose)

planting.note: Plant container-grown shrubs in spring in well-drained soil in full sun; Oso Easy Fragrant Spreader is notable within the series for genuine fragrance, a trait most landscape roses lack, on a low, wide-spreading habit.

directions: Plant in well-drained soil in full sun. Oso Easy Fragrant Spreader bears clear pink single flowers with an actual noticeable fragrance, a distinguishing feature within a series otherwise selected primarily for disease resistance and bloom rather than scent. Its low, wide-spreading habit makes it well suited to slopes, edging, or mass plantings where a groundcover effect is wanted alongside the low-maintenance disease resistance the Oso Easy series is known for. It blooms in flushes from late spring through frost without deadheading, tolerates heat and drought well once established, and needs only an annual light pruning in late winter to stay dense and floriferous.
